cd "$(dirname mjcf.xml)"; python - <<'EOF'
import mujoco, json
m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path("mjcf.xml")
joints=[]
for i in range(m.njnt):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,i)
    jt=int(m.jnt_type[i])
    typemap={0:"free",1:"ball",2:"slide",3:"hinge"}
    axis=m.jnt_axis[i].tolist()
    limited=bool(m.jnt_limited[i])
    rng=m.jnt_range[i].tolist() if limited else None
    joints.append(dict(name=name,type=typemap[jt],axis=axis,range=rng))
acts=[]
for i in range(m.nu):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR,i)
    trnid=m.actuator_trnid[i][0]; trntype=int(m.actuator_trntype[i])
    if trntype==0:
        jname=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,trnid)
    elif trntype==3:
        jname="tendon:"+mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_TENDON,trnid)
    else:
        jname=None
    cr=m.actuator_ctrlrange[i].tolist() if m.actuator_ctrllimited[i] else None
    acts.append(dict(name=name,joint=jname,ctrlrange=cr))
sites=[mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE,i) for i in range(m.nsite)]
bodies=[mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY,i) for i in range(m.nbody)]
# free joints
free=[]
for i in range(m.njnt):
    if int(m.jnt_type[i])==0:
        b=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY,m.jnt_bodyid[i])
        free.append(b)
out=dict(nv=m.nv,njnt=m.njnt,joints=joints,acts=acts,sites=sites,bodies=bodies,free=free)
json.dump(out,open("_parsed.json","w"),indent=1)
print("nv",m.nv,"njnt",m.njnt,"nu",m.nu)
print("sites",sites)
print("free",free)
EOF
